elements.text: Document: SQF # 11.2.E.A.1-1945 Daily Pre-Op 2nd Shift/Glass Breakage Inspection/ Drain Back-Up Inspection

elements.name: Texto 12
elements.text: Complete this inspection daily, following cleaning and sanitation, before the start of next production. Use "Not Applicable" (N/A) if a certain item does

elements.name: Texto 13
elements.text: not pertain. If glass or similar material breakage occurs or drains back-up at any other time than the routine pre-operational inspection, use #'s 1-6 to inspect the isolated,

elements.name: Texto 14
elements.text: affected area (including clothing and footwear) with the completion form.

elements.name: Texto 28
elements.text: 1. Food Processing Areas, Product Contact Surfaces, and Equipment Clean? (Dry Cleaning)

elements.name: Texto 29
elements.text:
2. Processing Lines Free of Debris? Standing water and Drains Not
Overflowing and Backing Up?

elements.name: Texto 30
elements.text: 3. Equipment, Packing & Raw Materials, and Product Intact? Reitz & Mixers

elements.name: Texto 30
elements.text: 4. Staff Amenities Free of Debris? No signs of Pest Activity? Garbage Cans Cleaned/Empty?

elements.name: Texto 31
elements.text: 5. Rate the effectiveness of the waste disposal (1-10, 10 being most effective)

elements.name: Texto 31
elements.text: 6. Sanitary Facilities Free of Debris and Hygiene Items Available? (Soap,Towels, Hot Water)?

elements.name: Texto 32
elements.text: 7. Clothing, including Shoes Clean, gloves and Maintained in a Serviceable Condition?

elements.name: Texto 32
elements.text: 8. Correct Lot # and printing on the package clear and readible?

elements.name: Texto 32
elements.text: 9. Scale is leveled and calibration current with sticker affixed on the scale?

elements.name: Texto 32
elements.text: 10. Are Packaging Materials Properly Stored and Protected in the warehouse at both sides of the hallway?
